title: Comparison of Logarithmic Hochschild Homologies
summary: We construct a comparison morphism $\operatorname{HH}^{\mathrm{Rog}}\to\operatorname{HH}^{\mathrm{Ols}}$ between Rognes' logarithmic Hochschild homology and Olsson's logarithmic Hochschild homology which generalizes the comparison between Gabber's log cotangent complex $\mathbb{L}^{\mathrm{Gab}}$ and Olsson's log cotangent complex $\mathbb{L}^{\mathrm{Ols}}.$ In particular, Olsson's comparison is recovered as the first associated graded piece of our comparison morphism $\operatorname{HH}^{\mathrm{Rog}}\to\operatorname{HH}^{\mathrm{Ols}}.$ In the development of this comparison, we also prove…
